limitations.quote: The existing square and sawtooth timing was preserved.
limitations.note: Preserving the square-wave timing left both terminal-count checks at 20 instead of 19, so the square wave still had a 21-clock period rather than a 20-clock period.

The triangle rewrite forced an upward step from zero and changed startup and mode-entry behavior, whereas the correct fix preserves the existing direction logic and moves the upper flag threshold from 20 to 19.

The testbench treated the faulty 21-clock square period as correct and likewise expected the rewritten triangle to rise immediately after reset, so passing did not validate either behavior against the intended design.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire test script to be rejected before simulation, requiring the agent to resubmit it with a different cleanup method.
